newsitem.title: USA: Datakey says will report a loss in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Datakey says will report a loss in 1997.

text.p: Datakey Inc said Thursday the company will report a loss in 1997, due to new product development.
The company said total 1997 revenue could exceed the $6.6 million reported for 1996.
"As a result of the substantial continuing investment in new product development, however, we will report a loss in 1997," chief executive officer Carl Boecher said in a news release.

"Reduced (original equipment manufacturer) product revenue is expected to continue through the first one or two quarters of 1997 and likely will result in a reduction in OEM products revenue for the year as compared to 1996," he said.

But new end-user products being developed for the information security marketplace are planned for sales introduction by mid-1997 and, based on current expectations, are expected to result in measurable revenue during the second half of 1997, the company said.
"If this revenue meets the company's present expectations we believe the total revenue in 1997 will exceed the 1996 level," Boecher said.

Also Thursday, the electronic product and services company reported a net loss of $1.2 million, or $0.43 a share in the fourth quarter of 1996, compared to a profit of $52,000, or $0.02 a share, in the 1995 fourth quarter.
Datakey shares closed down 1/4 at 3-1/4 Thursday.
